title: Issues in Sociology and Social Justice
description: In-depth examination of sociology's relationship with social control, public policy, social reform and social activism. Topics may include community service and/or experiential learning opportunities.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCI 436, SOCI 450.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.

items.text: declared Honours or Major in Sociology

recommendations: SOCI 215, and one of SOCI 315, SOCI 331, SOCI 335, SOCI 355 recommended prior to SOCI 436.
